text_block_list.text:
After our outing, as I returned to the 
academy alongside Matikanefukukitaru—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: A-Ahaha... I tripped and fell. ...Wait.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaah! My shoelace snaaaapped~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My geta strap snapped?! An absolute 
firesale of bad luck is heading my way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, what should we do! We can't just go 
home like this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I must do something... Even if it takes 
every ounce of my power, I must ward off 
this evil...!

With that said, she began chanting spell 
after spell.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hear my plea, hear my plea, 
abracadabra-dee~! Stay away, bad luck, 
stay faaaar away~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fngyaro~, fngyaroro~...! Great Year of 
Misfortune, begone—!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

The sun had completely set, and the savory 
aroma of dinner was drifting out from the 
dorms.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! Just one 
more... No, two more things and I'll be 
done!

She's been like this for an hour already. 
If I leave her alone, she might just keep 
going until nightfall.
choice_data_list: The bad luck's already been warded off.
Looks like we're having curry tonight.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Really!? Since when!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Now that you mention it, my shoulders 
do feel lighter...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, over there! Look!! What a 
magnificent four-leaf clover!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No matter how you look at it, this is 
proof that luck is on my side...! Now I 
can head back to the dorm with peace of 
mind!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, all's well that ends well~. What a 
blessing, truly a blessing~.

Afterward, upon learning dinner was curry, 
she was deeply grateful for the good luck 
charm's effect.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What's this?! Curry?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I do smell curry...! In that case, 
I must hurry home!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, b-but right now is my period of great 
misfortune... No, but, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: U... Ununununu~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Eureka! I bet the aroma of this curry 
has made all the bad luck scurry! Perfect! 
Nice!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And so, good-luck daaaaash!

The next day, she reported that "the curry 
was very delicious," and we also promised 
to look for sturdy shoelaces next time.
